attempts.summary: Repaired /srv/inventory on node1: created the inventorysvc service user and inventory-readers group, set recursive ownership to inventorysvc:inventory-readers, and set permissions to 750 (dirs) / 640 (files) so only the owner and group can access it and others are denied. Verified with positive (inventorysvc, group member) and negative (outsider/nobody) access tests, then confirmed all state and data survived a full node1 reboot (boot_id changed, confirming a real restart).
